dedupe_keys.name: retele de utilitati apa si canalizare

description: Retele de utilitati - apa si canalizare is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANCPI. The dataset Utility networks - water and sewerage contains spatial information collected from regional water-channel operators. The data were collected and validated in accordance with the Technical Rules for the Realisation of Spatial Data Sets on Utilities Networks. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Utility networks - water and sewerage" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
